AccentPremierCoupToolTip: Instrument played ON THE 1st hit of each cycle (the rest use the main instrument). Djembe: bass here, tone/slap above.
AucunCoupARienAFiger: No hit to freeze (every layer is muted or empty).
ConcateneCeRiffEtLeSuivant: Concatenates this block and the next (riff or melodic line) into a single riff; the silence between them is kept
ConvertitEnRiffOrdinaireNotes: Converts to an ordinary riff, with the explicit notes the engine picked at this point in the piece
FigerRiffPerdLesParametres: Freezing turns the polyrhythmic line into an ordinary riff (explicit notes). The Hits, Steps and Shift settings will be lost. Continue?
FusionneTousLesBlocsDeLa: Merges every block on the line (riffs + melodic lines) into a single riff, silences kept (to vary a whole theme at once)
GardeLaNoteTenueJusquALa: Holds the note until the next hit, instead of a short stab
GlisserPourDefinirLaFinDeBoucle: Drag to set the loop end (B)
ModePersonnaliseClic: Custom mode: click the ring's cells to switch hits on and off (the pattern is then stored as drawn)
PolyrythmicComposeShort: Drums + melodic line in Euclidean cycles
PolyrythmicComposeSubtitle: Polyrhythmic drums + melodic line: each layer runs its own Euclidean cycle E(K,N) on its own subdivision.
PolyrythmicIntentionHint: e.g. "12/8 feel with a cowbell on E(7,12), marimba bass in 5-against-8"
TourMixerText: Opens the mixer: set each track's volume, pan (left↔right) and mute/solo. It acts live during playback — move a fader and you hear it.
UnAnneauParVoixLeMoteurChoisit: One ring = one voice; the engine picks the pitches from the chords
VolumePanoramiqueMuteSoloParPiste: Volume, pan, mute/solo per track (acts live during playback)
TourOfferText: First time here? A short guided tour can walk you through the editor's features. Start it now?
TourWelcomeText: In a few steps, here's how to create chords, riffs, melodic lines and drums. Use Next (or →); Skip to leave.
TourTracksText: The "Track" menu: add an instrument or drum track, compose a whole piece with AI, or generate a ready-to-edit structure.
TourInsertText: The "Insert" menu: add chords, a riff (a melody/motif you edit note by note), a melodic line, a cadence or drums on the selected track.
TourKeyText: Pick the piece's key (note + mode) and transpose everything in one click.
TourMeterText: Change the time signature (4/4, 3/4, 6/8…) and toggle simple/compound.
TourChordEdText: This block is a chord. Down here you set its degree/quality, inversion, articulation (block, arpeggio…) and can attach a melodic cell to it.
TourRiffEdText: This block is a riff. The bottom editor lets you draw notes with the mouse, set their length, generate with AI, or record from mic/MIDI.
TourDrumEdText: This block is drums. Pick a category + pattern, density, a fill, and edit each hit in the grid. The kit is chosen in the track header.
TourPlayText: Start playback. The cursor starts at your position; ⟳ loops the A-B region.
TourUndoText: Made a mistake? Undo (Ctrl+Z) and redo (Ctrl+Y). Every timeline action is recorded.
TourImportText: Import a MIDI or MuseScore file to start from an existing piece.
TourEndText: Select a block on the timeline to edit it in the bottom panel. You can replay this tour from the home screen ("Tutorial" tile). Happy composing!
AChordProgressionInThePiece: A chord progression in the piece's key, from the chosen degree toward the tonic (no 7th on the tonic). The chords are inserted into the selected track.
AMelodicLineOnlyFixesThe: A melodic line only fixes the rhythm: the engine picks the notes from the current chords.
APIKeysStoredLocallySeveralPer: API keys stored locally (several per provider).
ATemplateCreatesACompletePiece: A template creates a complete piece in one click — or generate a bespoke one with “Add with AI”.
ATrackSButtonShowsIts: A track's ♫ button shows its score; M mutes the track, S solos it.
AddAtLeastATitleOr: Add at least a title or a description.
AddEditRemoveAPIKeysSettings: Add / edit / remove API keys (Settings → API keys)
AddsAMelodicLineRhythmOnly: Adds a melodic line (rhythm only, ≤ 3 voices) on a dedicated track; the engine picks the notes from the chords. Adding again appends a copy of the previous one.
AdjustPlaybackVolumePerInstrumentPiano: Adjust playback volume per instrument (piano, strings…).
AfficherCettePisteDansLaPartition: Show this track in the score
AlsoRequestADrumTrackThe: Also request a drum track: the AI places percussion (GM notes 35-81) on a dedicated kit track.
AppliesAVariationTechniqueToThe: Applies a variation technique to the selected riff (the theme): retrograde, inversion, ornamentation, augmentation, Fortspinnung, genetic…
AppliqueUneTechniqueDeVariationAu: Applies a variation technique to the selected riff (the original is kept).
AppliquerLeMotifACeuxDu: Apply the pattern to those with the same name
AstuceMenuInsererCadencePourGenerer: Tip: menu « Insert ▸ Cadence… » to generate a chord progression in the key (from this chord toward the tonic).
AttachTheCurrentProjectJSONFolded: Attach the current project (JSON, folded into the issue)
AttachTheCurrentProjectNoProject: Attach the current project (no project open)
AucunArrangementARegenererComposezD: No arrangement to regenerate (compose a structure first).
AucunFichierExploitableTrouveDansLes: No usable file found in the chosen folders.
AucunePisteMelodiqueAExporterCoche: No melodic track to export (tick a ♫ track or add an instrument track).
AucunePisteTrouveeDansLeFichier: No track found in the file.
AudioInOutNAudioMITLicence: Audio in/out: NAudio, MIT licence. Default SoundFont: MuseScore_General (MuseScore).
CDEFGA: C D E F G A B · Space=rest · Shift+letter=stack · ↑↓ ½t · Ctrl+↑↓ 8ve · Del · ←→=selection · 1-5=duration
CatalogueOfDrumPatternsStandardAfrica: Catalogue of drum patterns (Standard, Africa, Australia) + your saved, reusable patterns.
CetAccordNEstPasSur: This chord is not on a scale degree of the key — no suggestion.
ChangeADrumPatternAndThe: Change a drum pattern and the repeats adjust to keep the same length.
ChangeUnParametreStyleDegreMesures: Change a parameter (style, degree, bars…) then « Regenerate ». A single module: it stores each chord and the chord generator renders it (score, audio, export).
ChangingTheSoundFontReloadsTheInstrument: Changing the SoundFont reloads the instruments immediately. Changing the sample rate is applied the same way; restart a playing piece to hear it.
CheckAndIfNeededCorrectThe: Check and, if needed, correct the key of the imported piece.
CheckedRolledChordsStaggeredStartsCommon:
Checked: rolled chords (staggered starts + common sustain) are notated as ONE chord + arpeggio sweep.
Unchecked (default): each note is shown separately (real eighths/quarters).
CheckedTheCounterMelodyBecomesA: Checked: the counter-melody becomes a 2nd voice of the melody (same staff). Unchecked: its own track/staff.
ChoisirUnDossierDePartitionsMIDI: Choose a folder of scores / MIDI to analyze
ChoisisLaPisteAChargerDans: Choose the track to load into the riff. The timeline is not changed — you edit the riff afterward.
ChoisisLeStylePersonnalisePourEditer: Choose the « Custom… » style to edit the rhythm by hand.
ChoisissezLaGammeCibleLesNotes: Choose the target scale. Notes are transposed to the nearest (up or down, whichever is shortest).
ChoisitLeRenversementDeChaqueAccord: Chooses the inversion of each chord so the notes (the fingers) move as little as possible
ChordsGoOnTheChordsTrack: Chords go on the “Chords” track at the bottom; insert a cadence for a ready-made progression.
ChordsInADedicatedVoiceEmpty: Chords in a dedicated voice (empty articulation)
ClearAllTheNotesInThe: Clear all the notes in the riff
CliqueGlissePourDessinerLesNotes: Click/drag to draw notes; drag again over a note to erase it; click the ruler = cursor.
CocheAuMoinsUnePistePour: Tick at least one track (♫) to export it as a score.
CocheChangerUnAccordTransposeAUSSI: Ticked: changing a chord ALSO transposes the melody. Unticked: only the bass and accompaniment are rebuilt (to fit the chords under the melody).
CommentChaqueAccordEstJouePlaque: How each chord is played (block, arpeggio, jazz, bossa, funk…) instead of plain sustained chords
ComposeArrangeAndSequenceYourPieces: Compose, arrange and sequence your pieces.
ConvertiEnModuleBatteriePourEntendre: Converted to a drum module. To hear the percussion, place it on a Drums track (otherwise it plays with that track's instrument).
CopierCeMotifDansUnMotif: Copy this pattern into a custom pattern editable by hand.
CopiesThePromptWithoutCallingThe: Copies the prompt (without calling the API): paste it into an AI chat, then come back with “Paste the response”.
CopiesThePromptWithoutCallingThe2: Copies the prompt (without calling the API) to the clipboard: paste it into an AI chat, then bring back the response with “Paste the response”. Handy with no API key.
CounterMelodyOnTheSameStaff: Counter-melody on the same staff (2 voices)
ExporterLeFormatSuitLExtension: Export (Ctrl+E) — the format follows the extension you choose: .wav, .mp3, .mid, .musicxml, .mscx, .pdf
EnregistrerSousUneAutreNom: Save under another name, leaving the original file untouched
DecochePourUneFrappeUniforme: Uncheck for a flat, uniform touch: every note at the same level, like the editor's preview
DecaleCetteVoixDeNOctaves: Shift this voice by N octaves (0 = the voice's natural register)
ProfondeurDeLaPisteDansLa: How far back the track sits in the room — without touching its level
CercleVide: Empty circle — click to place hits
ModePersonnaliseClic: Custom mode: click ring cells to toggle hits on/off (the pattern is then persisted as-is)
PolyrythmicComposeSubtitle: Polyrhythmic drums + melody: each layer runs its own Euclidean E(K,N) cycle on its own subdivision.
AccentPremierCoupToolTip: Instrument played on the FIRST hit of each cycle (the rest plays on the main instrument). Djembé pattern: bass here, tone/slap above.
PolyrythmicIntentionHint: e.g. '12/8 feel with cowbell E(7,12) and a 5-on-8 marimba bass'
ConvertitEnMotifDeBatterieOrdinaire: Converts to an ordinary drum motif, editable hit by hit
FigerPerdLesParametres: Freezing turns the polyrhythm into hits. The Hits, Steps and Shift settings will be lost. Continue?
AjouteUnCalquePourCommencer: Add a layer to get started
PlusieursCalquesChacunSurSonMotif: Several layers, each on its own Euclidean pattern
DecalerCetteLigneDUnPas: Shift this lane by one step — the number of hits stays the same
DarkTealInterfaceMovableDialogsRicher: Dark & teal interface, movable dialogs, richer editors.
DecocheUnSeulRiffParGroupe: Unticked = a single riff per group (no Set-volume nodes) → far fewer nodes on long pieces.
DecrisUneIntentionDeGrooveL: Describe a groove intention; the AI generates a percussion pattern and applies it to this module.
DecrisUneIntentionLIAEcrit: Describe an intention; the AI writes the riff melody over the present chords (or suggests chords if the area is empty).
DeleteEverythingAfterTheCursorThe: Delete everything after the cursor (the riff stops at the cursor)
DeleteEverythingBeforeTheCursorAnd: Delete everything before the cursor (and bring the rest to the start)
DescribeASTYLEAndAnIntention: Describe a STYLE and an intention (e.g. “melancholic Chopin waltz”). The AI returns a template; check it, then Confirm to save it.
DescribeAStyleALengthThe: Describe a style + a length; the AI generates chords, sections, articulations and melodic lines, placed on the timeline (free API key: console.mistral.ai)
DescribeAStyleALengthThe2: Describe a style + a length; the AI generates a piece, opened in a new tab.
DescribeAStyleAnIntentionThe: Describe a style + an intention; the AI generates a template that you confirm and save.
DescribeAStyleAndAnIntention: Describe a style and an intention; the AI proposes chords, sections, melodies and drums, placed on the timeline.
DescribeAStyleTheAIArranges: Describe a style, the AI arranges the piece.
DescribeWhatYouWereDoingWhat: Describe what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened (or your idea).
DessineSeulementLeRYTHMEUneLigne: Draws only the RHYTHM (one line per voice). The engine picks notes from the current chord (arrangement grid in structure, otherwise the chords track). Chord notes on strong beats, passing notes on weak ones. « Save » (below the grid) saves the pattern under a name.
DisponibleSurUneMusiqueStructureePiste: Available on a structured piece (Track → Create structure…).
DisponibleUniquementSurUneMusiqueStructu: Available only on a structured piece (Track → Create structure…).
DoubleClicPourChangerLeDegre: Double-click to change the degree and color
DragToSetThePlaybackStart: Drag to set the playback start point
DrawAgainFromTheModelS: Draw again from the model's banks with a new pick
EGDarkMusicReminiscentOf: e.g. “dark music”, “reminiscent of childhood”, “mystical flute + marimba, with a drone”
EGMelancholicChopinWaltzGhibli: e.g. “melancholic Chopin waltz”, “Ghibli 6/8 ballad”, “jazz bossa nova”
EcarteChaqueAccordPositionOuverteAu: Spreads each chord (open position) instead of a tight stack
EditorTempoBPMPreviewCursorAdvance: Editor tempo (BPM): preview + cursor advance in MIDI/audio
ExportTheCheckedTracksAsAn: Export the checked tracks (♫) as an A4 score (PDF print)
ExportTheScoreAsANative: Export the score as a native MuseScore file (.mscx)
ExportTheScoreAsMusicXML: Export the score in the exchange format read by every notation program (.musicxml)
ExportTheTimelineAsAMIDI: Export the timeline as a MIDI file (.mid)
FigeLesHauteursQueLeMoteur: Freezes the pitches the engine chose on the chords into a normal riff: each note becomes individually editable (the rhythm-only line is replaced at the same position).
Gemini25ThinkingBudgetAuto: Gemini 2.5 “thinking” budget. Auto = the model decides (best quality). Lower = faster / cheaper (possibly lower quality); 0 = off. No effect on other providers.
GenerateOrPasteAResponseFirst: Generate or paste a response first.
GeneratesA100ProceduralThemeSerial: Generates a 100% procedural theme (serial, cellular automaton, L-system, genetic, 1/f fractal, Thue-Morse) on the active track — or replaces the selected section in the structure
GeneratesACoherentMelodyChordsDrums: Generates a coherent melody + chords + drums in the current key, in a given style. Run again for another variant.
GeneratesAnEditableArrangementFrameworkF: Generates an editable arrangement framework (Form × Style × Mood): melody, counter-melody, accompaniment, bass, pad — editable afterwards
GeneratesAnEditableArrangementFrameworkP: Generates an editable arrangement framework: pick a FORM (sonata, rondo, ABAC…) — it builds the structure + harmonic plan; the STYLE gives it soul (theme, accompaniment).
GlisserPourDefinirLePointDe: Drag to set the playback start point
GlisserPourDeplacerClicDroitPour: Drag to move · double-click to reset · right-click to delete
HigherARepeatedBowStrokeOn: Higher = a repeated bow stroke on the same note more readily creates a new note (violin détaché).
IfUncheckedDefaultAudioDetectionIs: If unchecked (default), audio detection is chromatic; checked, detected notes snap to the editor's scale.
ImportAFileIntoTheRiff: Import a file into the riff
ImportAMIDIOrMuseScoreFile: Import a MIDI or MuseScore file
ImportATrackFromAMIDI: Import a track from a MIDI or MuseScore file into this riff (the timeline is not changed)
ImporterUnePisteDansLeRiff: 🎼 Import a track into the riff
ImportsAMIDIOrMuseScoreFile: Imports a MIDI or MuseScore file straight into the timeline (Import…).
InARhythmicPatternANegative: In a rhythmic pattern, a negative duration = a rest — to give phrases air and structure.
InTheDrumEditorPickA: In the drum editor, pick a pattern by category, or draw your own and save it to reuse it everywhere.
LeFichierEstAnalyseA24: The file is analyzed at 24 slices/beat; another value resamples the riff.
LeRiffEstVideRienA: The riff is empty — nothing to apply.
LiveAudioInputMonophonicDetectionAdds: Live audio input (monophonic detection) → adds the played notes
MBNowItWillBeInstalled: MB) now? It will be installed and selected automatically.
MIDIDevicePlayedInTheEditor: MIDI device played in the editor
MarkersLaneHint: Double-click to add a section marker.
MelodicLineRhythmOnlyTheEngine: “Melodic line” = rhythm only, the engine picks the pitches (contour/anchor). “Full melody” = the AI writes explicit notes (riffs).
MelodicLinesRhythmOnlyTheEngine: Melodic lines (rhythm only, the engine picks the notes) instead of written riffs
MotifDuCatalogueAppliqueCliquePersonnali: Catalog pattern applied. Click « Customize » to edit it by hand.
MixerHint: Per-track faders, pans and insert effects — live during playback.
MuseScoreGeneralSf2IsAGood: MuseScore_General.sf2 is a good default choice.
MusiqueSerielleAlgorithmiqueAucunModeleA: Serial & algorithmic music (no learned model). See docs/algorithmic-composition-nierhaus.md.
N44ParDefautDansLe: 4/4 by default in the file — check the meter.
N44ParDefautRythmeTernaire: 4/4 by default + ternary rhythm detected → 6/8 suggested.
NAME: NAME
NoSoundFontIsInstalledNoSound: No SoundFont is installed: no sound can be produced.
NoTrackFoundInThisFile: No track found in this file.
NoUsableSoundFontNoSoundCan: No usable SoundFont: no sound can be produced.
NomDuModeleLeNomDetermine: Model name (the name determines the style: « bach », « vivaldi », « keyboard », otherwise melodic):
NombreDeTempsDureeDeLa: Number of beats (length of the line)
NonEcraseQuandOnAppliqueLa: Not overwritten when applying the cell to all chords of the same name
OnStructuredMusicComposesAnExtra: On structured music: composes an extra melodic voice (new instrument) over the existing grid and structure, inserted between the melodic voices and the accompaniment
OnStructuredMusicCreatesAnAccompaniment: On structured music: creates an accompaniment track of CHORD OBJECTS (one per bar, by degree), with an editable pattern shared per section
OrdresDesChainesDeMarkovMelodie: Markov chain orders (melody & harmony) — longer context = more character, but closer to the corpus:
PasteTheJSONCopiedFromAn: Paste the JSON copied from an AI chat: check it, then click Confirm to apply it.
PasteTheJSONCopiedFromThe: Paste the JSON copied from the AI chat: it is parsed as a piece, ready to apply to the timeline.
PickAKeyByNameManage: Pick a key by name. Manage them (several per provider) via “Manage…”.
PickAModelFromTheList: Pick a model from the list (it depends on the provider) or type a custom id.
PickASf2FileFromDisk: Pick a .sf2 file from disk (copied into your data and selected)
PickATemplateJsonFileAnd: Pick a template .json file and add it to the folder.
SwingDelaysTheOffEighths: Swing: delays the off-beat eighths (uneven eighths). Affects playback and audio export only; the score and MIDI export keep straight eighths.
PickupLengthOfTheIncompleteOpening: Pickup: length of the incomplete opening bar (the barlines shift by that much). Does not affect playback.
PlayTheMetronomeAtTheEditor: Play the metronome at the editor's tempo
ProjectTemplatesFromAFileWith: Project templates: from a file, with AI, or added to the folder — with deletion.
PromptCopiedPasteItIntoAn: Prompt copied. Paste it into an AI chat, then come back with “Paste the response”.
PropagerAuxSectionsDeriveesReExpo: Propagate to derived sections (recap / development / conclusion)
ProtegeCeRiffDeLaRegeneration: Protects this riff from regeneration by « Apply the theme ».
ReOuvrirUnModeleExistantDossiers: Re-open an existing model (folders + orders) to re-analyze it
RemplaceCeRiffParUnModule: Replaces this riff with a drum module at the custom rhythm: keeps the notes and durations as they are (each pitch → its GM percussion).
ReplaysTheDetectedNotesOverMIDI: Replays the detected notes over MIDI. Uncheck it if you're already playing the instrument through the audio input (🎤).
ReportABugOrASuggestion: Report a bug or a suggestion
ReporterCeRiffCommeThemeRe: Carry this riff over as a theme: recap / development / conclusion + counter-melody regenerated on the chords of each bar.
ResponsePastedCheckTheJSONAdvanced: Response pasted. Check the JSON (Advanced), then click Confirm.
ResponseReceivedCheckTheJSONAdvanced: Response received. Check the JSON (Advanced), then click Confirm.
RiffModeSnapsWrongNotesOn: Riff mode: snaps wrong notes — on the beat → chord note, off the beat → scale note (only out-of-scale/chord notes move).
RiffSReExpositionDeveloppementConclusion: riff(s) (recap, development, conclusion + counter-melody), transposed to the chords.
SelectionneDAbordUnRiffLe: Select a riff (the theme) to vary first.
SelectionneUnModuleRiffAccordBatterie: Select a module (riff, chord, drums, melodic line) on the timeline to edit it here.
SeveralAPIKeysPerProviderChosen: Several API keys per provider, chosen by name in the compose screens.
SmallerLowerLatencyAndBetterDetache: Smaller = lower latency and better détaché detection, but less reliable on low notes. Takes effect the next time the audio input (🎤) starts.
SoundFontAudioSynthesisMeltySynthNobuaki: SoundFont audio synthesis: MeltySynth — © Nobuaki Tanaka, MIT licence.
SoundFontsAreNotShippedWithThe: SoundFonts are not shipped with the app (several hundred MB).
StopRealTimeMIDIAudioInput: Stop real-time MIDI/audio input (freezes the cursor) — or the Esc key
StoresSeveralAPIKeysPerProvider: Stores several API keys per provider (Settings ▸ API keys) and switches between them by name.
StoresSeveralKeysPerProviderE: Stores several keys per provider (e.g. several Gemini projects) and pick them by name in the compose screens.
StructuredAITemplatesIntroThemeDevelopme: Structured AI templates (intro/theme/development/outro), expanded to the desired length.
SuitesClasseesSelonLesAccordsPrecedents: Progressions ranked by the preceding chords, the bar and the mood. ★ = recommended. Hover to listen.
SwitchBetweenTheSCOREOfThe: Switch between the SCORE (of the checked ♫ tracks) and the EDITOR of the selected module
ThankYouTheProblemHasBeen: ✓ Thank you! The problem has been reported to the development team.
ThankYouYourSuggestionHasBeen: ✓ Thank you! Your suggestion has been sent to the development team.
TheChordsTrackStaysSILENTEmpty: The Chords track stays SILENT (empty custom pattern) — it only serves as a harmonic marker for the melodic lines. The AI writes the chord content, voiced as it sees fit, in a dedicated “Chords” voice (explicit notes).
TheClipboardIsEmptyCopyThe: The clipboard is empty — copy the AI's JSON response first.
TheReportIsPublishedAsA: ⚠ The report is published as a public issue on GitHub. Do not put anything confidential in it.
TheUpdateWillBeDownloadedThen: The update will be downloaded then launched; the app will close to install it.
ThenSelectItInSettingsAudio: then select it in Settings → Audio.
ThisBuildHasNoEmbeddedGitHub: This build has no embedded GitHub token: the report cannot be sent.
TimeSignatureChangingTheNumberOf: Time signature — changing the number of beats reorganises the riffs and rests
Title: Title
ToFixThisPlaceASf2: To fix this, place a .sf2 file in:
ToggleSimpleCompoundX4X: Toggle simple ⇄ compound (x/4 ⇄ x/8) — changes neither the riffs nor their length, only the notation (3 eighths ⇄ triplets)
TransposeAllNotesToAnotherScale: Transpose all notes to another scale (nearest: up or down, whichever is shortest)
UncheckedFrameworkAccompanimentOnlyNoMel: Unchecked: framework + accompaniment only (no melody/counter-melody), to lay down your own melody.
VagueNotesParArc0Auto: Wave: notes per arc (0 = auto; small = undulates fast)
YouCanTryAgainAtThe: You can try again at the next startup, or place a .sf2 file manually (see Settings → Audio).
ZoomDefilementBoutonImprimerPourLe: (zoom + scroll; Print button for the PDF)
ZoomFitTip: Fit the zoom to show the whole piece
ConvertitEnAccordsPatternGenerateur: Converts to individual chords (PatternGenerator), one per chord.
DureeDuCycleIndependanteDesAccords: Duration of the wheel CYCLE (in beats) — the rings run at this speed independently of the chords. A short chord just moves to the next one at its boundary, without speeding up the notes.
FigerPolyChordPerdParametres: Freezing loses the euclidean parameters (Hits/Steps/Rotation): the module is replaced by N ordinary chords. Continue?
GraineAleatoireReproductible: Seed for the random draw (makes the result reproducible).
IndexNoteAccord0Grave: Chord note index (0 = lowest after voicing). Wraps around the octave in both directions: on a triad, +3 = root one octave higher, −1 = fifth one octave lower, −3 = root one octave lower, etc.
ListeDaccordsSurAnneauxEuclidiens: List of chords played by polyrhythmic rings.
PolyChordUnAnneauSweep: One ring, sweep across the chord
PolyChordsOptionTip: The Chords track is played by a SERIES of polyrhythmic chord modules (wheels of euclidean rings) of at most 4 bars each — at least one different polyrhythm per section — instead of one chord module per bar. The harmonic progression stays the same: only the way it is played changes. Excludes “Chords in a dedicated voice”.
PolyDrumsOptionTip: The drums are played by a series of polyrhythmic modules (euclidean rings E(hits, steps)) of at most 4 bars each, one per range the AI describes — they may fall silent elsewhere — instead of the usual percussion phrases. Requires the drum track.
AnUnexpectedErrorOccurredYouCan: An unexpected error occurred. You can send it as a report: the technical detail below will be attached.
ThankYouTheErrorHasBeen: Thank you, the error has been sent.
